sel features

genes <- data.frame(gene=rownames(seuratM)) %>% 
  mutate(geneID=gsub("^.*\\.", "", gene))

selGenes <- data.frame(geneID=c("ACTA2", "MYH6", "COL1A1", "MYH11")) %>% 
  left_join(., genes, by="geneID")

pList <- sapply(selGenes$gene, function(x){
  p <- FeaturePlot(seuratM, features = x, reduction = "umap", pt.size = 0.1, cols = c("lightgrey", "#BE3144"), raster = FALSE) +
    theme(legend.position="right")
  plot(p)
})

dotplot inflammatory genes

seuratM$clusterName <- factor(seuratM$clusterName, levels = c("CM", "Fb", "PerivFb", "BEC1", "BEC2", "VSMC", "NC", "LEC", "Mph1", "Mph2", "Tcell", "Bcell", "Adipoc"))
Idents(seuratM) <- seuratM$clusterName

genes <- data.frame(gene=rownames(seuratM)) %>% 
  mutate(geneID=sub("^.*\\.", "", gene))

# Create selGenes with geneID vector, join, and filter
selGenes <- data.frame(geneID = rev(c("IL1B", "IL1R1", "IL6", "IL6R", "TNF", "TNFRSF1A", "TNFRSF1B", "IL18", "IL18R1", "IL15", "IL15RA", "IFNG", "IFNGR1", "IFNG-AS1", "IFNAR1", "IFNAR2", "IFNA5"))) %>%
  left_join(., genes, by = "geneID")%>%
  filter(!is.na(gene))

  
# Run dot plot
dittoSeq::dittoDotPlot(seuratM, vars = selGenes$gene, group.by = "clusterName") + RotatedAxis() + coord_flip() + scale_color_viridis(option= "F")

                   cols = c("lightgrey", "#BE3144"), 
                   raster = FALSE, 
                   order=FALSE) +
    theme(legend.position="right")

})
